The '''Assembly Droid FA-19''' was a [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] model produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] that was used to maintain the assembly line of the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].
